name: SugarFlexbox
description: Flex-style box layout plus a sortable/filterable table for terminal grids.

name: SugarForms
description: Form engine (port of charmbracelet/huh) plus the raw component implementations that sugar-widgets re-exports — Groups, themes, validators, fuzzy / async suggestions.

name: SugarFuzzy
description: Fuzzy string matcher that returns which characters matched and their score. Two algorithms: Smith-Waterman (local alignment) and Sahilm (gum-style). Enables filter-highlighting UIs impossible with score-only matchers.

name: SugarGallery
description: Browse-grid widgets for media TUIs: a 2-D virtualized PosterGrid that holds only the cards on screen (sparse, absolute-indexed) and emits a need-range window for owner-driven paging, a Rail carousel, and a renderer-agnostic PosterCard. Immutable.

name: SugarImage
description: Image-to-cell renderer for the terminal — Sixel, Kitty, iTerm2, chafa CLI, or Unicode half/quarter block, ASCII ramp, and the chafa symbol engine.

name: SugarInput
description: EscapeDecoder consumes raw TTY bytes and emits typed Events. Supports legacy keys, Kitty keyboard protocol, xterm modifyOtherKeys, SGR 1006/1016, urxvt 1015 and X10 mouse, focus events, and bracketed paste. Native PHP — decoding semantics follow charmbracelet/bubbletea.

name: SugarLog
description: Colorful leveled logger.

name: SugarMetrics
